=== examples: ./verify --help
exit 0
--- stdout
| One entry point for every gate: CI, git hooks and agent hooks all call this script and
| nothing else, so they cannot drift apart.
|
|   ./verify [ROOT]          fast checks (seconds): spine soundness, behaviors, stale checks,
|                            conformance, content checks, and the path guard when a base is given
|   ./verify [ROOT] --full   also checks the checker (mutation)
|
| ROOT is a folder laid out like a project: spec/, checks/, conformance/, src/, mutation/.
| Without ROOT: this folder when it has spec/, otherwise every examples/*/ in turn.
|
| Nothing is skipped silently: a step that does not run prints a skip line with the reason,
| and a missing piece (no spine, no adapter, no content checks, no mutation script under
| --full) is an error.
|
| Every piece is a .cmd file holding one command line, in any language:
| conformance/adapter_<machine>.cmd, checks/run.cmd, mutation/mutate_<name>.cmd. A command runs
| from its root, without a shell, with tools/ first on its PATH, so a line can name a helper
| such as adapter_shim.py or run_checks.py, and with VERIFY_SPINE set to the command line that
| runs spine; checks and mutation pass when it exits 0.
|
| spine is the Go one in tools/, which every run builds into tools/bin/spine with Go; Go's
| build cache makes that quick when nothing changed. Without Go, every step fails.
|
| Environment:
|   VERIFY_BASE     commit to diff against; turns on the path guard (CI sets this)
|   VERIFY_BRANCH   branch name the guard maps to a role (default: current git branch)
|   VERIFY_REPORTS  folder for JUnit reports from the spine steps
|   VERIFY_VERBOSE  1 prints every step's output, not only failures
|
| Exit 0 when everything passes, 1 when any step fails, 2 when the script is misused.
|
--- stderr
|
